components.name: Complete lower-band window/realized root collision classification and minimal repair
components.project_addition: Strengthen P017 L055 in two layers. First, its r>=5 and s>=8 exclusions reduce every exact-window collision to 5<=k<=11, giving the complete raw-window root collision set (5,2,3,3),(6,2,3,4),(8,2,3,5). Second, apply the least-prime p-rough admissibility filter: the k=6,p=3 root-4 witness uses q=16 and n=48, whose least prime is 2, so the complete realized-shell collision set is only (5,2,3,3) and (8,2,3,5). The P023 finite repair-multiplicity theorem then gives the exact minimum root-shell repair alphabet: two symbols only at k=5,8 and one otherwise for k>=4. The uniform threshold bit 1[q>floor(k(k+2)/3)] is the p=2 shell indicator, while a task-minimal repair activates it only at k=5,8, separating informative features from necessary repair state.
